title: Introducing SILE: A New Typesetting System
summary: The SILE author's FOSDEM 2015 talk introducing SILE, a TeX-inspired typesetting system with frame-based layout, Unicode, OpenType and a Lua-based extensible design.
why: Pointed to as the standard introduction to SILE as a modern TeX alternative, though possibly dated.

quote.text: was nice introduction, although I don't know how up to date it is
